title: Calculate the percentage of nitrogen atoms among all atoms in carcinogenic
question: Calculate the percentage of nitrogen atoms among all atoms in carcinogenic molecules that contain triple bonds. Also identify which element appears in the fewest number of such molecules.

prediction.sql:
WITH target_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule m
    INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
      AND b.XCL_006 = '#'
),
atom_counts AS (
    SELECT
        a.XCL_003 AS element,
        COUNT(a.XCL_001) AS atom_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_002) AS molecule_count
    FROM atom a
    INNER JOIN target_molecules tm ON a.XCL_002 = tm.XCL_010
    GROUP BY a.XCL_003
),
totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(atom_count) AS total_atoms
    FROM atom_counts
)
SELECT
    CAST(COALESCE((SELECT atom_count FROM atom_counts WHERE element = 'n'), 0) AS REAL) * 100 / t.total_atoms AS nitrogen_percentage,
    (SELECT element FROM atom_counts ORDER BY molecule_count ASC, element ASC LIMIT 1) AS least_common_element
FROM totals t

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH target_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule m
    INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
      AND b.XCL_006 = '#'
),
atom_counts AS (
    SELECT
        a.XCL_003 AS element,
        COUNT(a.XCL_001) AS atom_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_002) AS molecule_count
    FROM atom a
    INNER JOIN target_molecules tm ON a.XCL_002 = tm.XCL_010
    GROUP BY a.XCL_003
),
totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(atom_count) AS total_atoms
    FROM atom_counts
)
SELECT
    CAST(COALESCE((SELECT atom_count FROM atom_counts WHERE element = 'n'), 0) AS REAL) * 100 / t.total_atoms AS nitrogen_percentage,
    (SELECT element FROM atom_counts ORDER BY molecule_count ASC, element ASC LIMIT 1) AS least_common_element
FROM totals t

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.XCL_005 AS molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = 'triple'
),
carcinogenic_molecules AS (
    SELECT m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = 'carcinogenic'
),
target_molecules AS (
    SELECT tbm.molecule_id
    FROM triple_bond_molecules tbm
    JOIN carcinogenic_molecules cm ON tbm.molecule_id = cm.molecule_id
),
atom_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        a.XCL_003 AS element,
        COUNT(*) AS atom_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_002) AS molecule_count
    FROM atom a
    JOIN target_molecules tm ON a.XCL_002 = tm.molecule_id
    GROUP BY a.XCL_003
),
total_atoms AS (
    SELECT SUM(atom_count) AS total
    FROM atom_counts
),
nitrogen_percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT atom_count FROM atom_counts WHERE element = 'N') * 100.0 / (SELECT total FROM total_atoms) AS pct
    FROM total_atoms
),
min_element AS (
    SELECT element
    FROM atom_counts
    ORDER BY molecule_count ASC, element ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    np.pct AS nitrogen_percentage,
    me.element AS least_common_element
FROM nitrogen_percentage np
CROSS JOIN min_element me

react.raw_react_sql:
WITH target_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule m
    INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
      AND b.XCL_006 = '#'
),
atom_counts AS (
    SELECT
        a.XCL_003 AS element,
        COUNT(a.XCL_001) AS atom_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_002) AS molecule_count
    FROM atom a
    INNER JOIN target_molecules tm ON a.XCL_002 = tm.XCL_010
    GROUP BY a.XCL_003
),
totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(atom_count) AS total_atoms
    FROM atom_counts
)
SELECT
    CAST(COALESCE((SELECT atom_count FROM atom_counts WHERE element = 'n'), 0) AS REAL) * 100 / t.total_atoms AS nitrogen_percentage,
    (SELECT element FROM atom_counts ORDER BY molecule_count ASC, element ASC LIMIT 1) AS least_common_element
FROM totals t
